data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 暖桌蜜柑的分享
data.description: 【士道家暖桌·冬夜】十香穿着柔软针织衫盘腿坐在暖桌前，认真剥开一颗蜜柑并把最甜的一瓣留到最后；她忽然把那一瓣递向镜头，紫瞳里写满“这次轮到你吃”。
data.location: Shido’s warm living room in winter
data.action: 暖桌前剥蜜柑把最甜一瓣递向镜头，眼神全是分享食物的期待
data.lighting: amber kotatsu light and quiet snowfall beyond the window
data.mood: 把普通晚餐变成精灵的分享仪式
data.promptProse: Cross-legged beneath the kotatsu, Tohka Yatogami carefully removes each strand from a winter mandarin and offers its sweetest segment toward the viewer with both hands. Her cream knitted sweater, purple trousers and warm socks accompany eager eyes and swaying dark-purple hair. The vertical medium view includes the tabletop and window beyond. Amber kotatsu light warms her palms and fruit, while quiet snowfall cools the window's distant background.
